finishOrderingProbe.timingDefinition: Evaluate the same swept pair geometry and outward wall-boundary crossing on the final fixed 0.05-second integration interval, partitioned at the interpolated first-finish fraction. Contact eligibility also respects the existing one-contact-per-race limit. These are ordering diagnostics, not applied impacts or a continuous collision solver.

method.recoveryMetricNotes: lateralToleranceSettledAt is the timestamp of the first three consecutive samples within 0.25 m after a real out-of-band excursion; an excursion resets the candidate entry. It is a lateral-only diagnostic, distinct from the combined heading-and-lateral recenter condition.
method.summaryNotes: One shared PRNG performance sequence per seed/race across all experiment arms. Recovery stages and max lane error are measured per participant from the fixed-step trajectory. Full trajectories are intentionally omitted from this compact artifact; rerun this script to reproduce them.
